title.narrative: Polismyndigheten - Kapacitetsutveckling av gränsförvaltning i Somalia
Swedish Police Authority - Capacity development in border management in Somalia

description.narrative: The project aims to strengthen Somalias institutional capacity to effectively manage migration and reintegrate returning migrants by enhancing state capacity to maintain effective, rights-based and transparent border management. This will be done by enhancing; Operational capacity; supporting the establishment of an ICA (Immigration and Citizenship Agency) training academy, including development and implementation of curriculum and trainings; provision of trainings to ICA (Immigration and Citizenship Agency) officials on border management processes; provision of trainings to The Somali Police Criminal Investigation Division (CID) officials on investigation techniques on irregular migration and cross-border crime.

Projektet syftar till att stärka Somalias institutionella kapacitet att effektivt hantera migration och återintegrera återvändande migranter genom att stärka statens förmåga att säkerställa en effektiv, rättighetsbaserad och transparent gränsförvaltning. Detta ska uppnås genom att stärka den operativa kapaciteten genom stöd till etableringen av en utbildningsakademi inom Immigration and Citizenship Agency (ICA), inklusive utveckling och genomförande av läroplaner och utbildningsinsatser; genom tillhandahållande av utbildning för anställda på Immigration and Citizenship Agency (ICA) i gränsförvaltningsprocesser; samt genom utbildning för anställda på The Somali Police Criminal Investigation Division (CID) i utredningsmetoder kopplade till irreguljär migration och gränsöverskridande brottslighet.

The project aims to strengthen Somalia’s institutional capacity to effectively manage migration and reintegrate returning migrants by enhancing state capacity to maintain effective, rights-based and transparent border management. This will be done by enhancing; Operational capacity; supporting the establishment of an ICA (Immigration and Citizenship Agency) training academy, including development and implementation of curriculum and trainings; provision of trainings to ICA (Immigration and Citizenship Agency) officials on border management processes; provision of trainings to The Somali Police Criminal Investigation Division (CID) officials on investigation techniques on irregular migration and cross-border crime.
